body:
template/.github/workflows/check-gates.yml.jinja line 27 runs `pdca gates --working-tree`, but pyproject.toml.jinja installs the console script under `{{ cli_name }}`. copier.yml explicitly recommends namespacing cli_name when several instances share a machine (e.g. "pdca-gramps") — any instance that follows that advice gets a merge re-gate that fails command-not-found on every PR, and the failure looks like a broken CI runner rather than a render bug.

Found by self-hosting: the pdca-pdca instance rendered with cli_name = "pdca-pdca" hit it immediately (eduralph/pdca-pdca#1).

Fix: template the invocation (`{{ cli_name }} gates --working-tree`) — and worth a render-check assertion that no rendered file still carries the bare `pdca ` invocation when cli_name differs, so the class (docs/workflows quoting the default command name literally) stays caught.
title: check-gates.yml.jinja hardcodes `pdca`; a namespaced cli_name breaks the CI re-gate
